name: Transit Time Planned route calculation
description:
Calculation of planned route. Planned route is the detailed view of transit time where all stops and transports are included. Production points identifiers (id, type and country) are NOTIS identifiers.
Additional attribute to responses may be added at any time without prenotice. Consumers must be tolerant to unknown attributes.
See [Transit Time service API documentation](https://developer.postnord.com/apis/details?systemName=transport-v1-transittime-calculation) for more information about transit time and planned route.
